metrics.name: dynamicHandlingMillisecondsPerScheduledEvent
metrics.eligibility: completed sample; correctness gates pass; scheduledEventCount > 0; finite nonnegative numerator
metrics.aggregation: sample value; within-block natural-log ratio; campaign/factor/matrix estimands
metrics.independentUnit: Williams block for shared goal; matched superblock for heterogeneous cross-family
metrics.zeroMissingNonfiniteTimeout: zero is not log-transformable; retain failure/missing row and reason; no pseudocount; timeout/failure remains in eligibility accounting
metrics.forbiddenConclusion: No superiority if correctness or structural eligibility fails.

metrics.name: dynamicHandlingP95Milliseconds
metrics.formula: within-sample P95 of eligible dynamic-event handling durations
metrics.denominator: eligible dynamic events within one sample
metrics.eligibility: completed sample; event-level P95 field is finite and nonnegative; correctness gates pass
metrics.aggregation: sample event-distribution P95; never cross-repeat P95 of sample means
metrics.zeroMissingNonfiniteTimeout: no pseudocount; missing/invalid retained as ineligible with reason; timeout/failure retained in accounting
metrics.forbiddenConclusion: Must not relabel a cross-repeat percentile as event-level P95.

metrics.name: totalPlannerElapsedMillisecondsPerAgent-and-agentCountScalingSlope
metrics.formula: totalPlannerElapsedMilliseconds / agentCount; plus separately preregistered cross-agent-count slope
metrics.unit: milliseconds-per-agent and log-time slope per frozen agent-count scale
metrics.denominator: eligible agents; controlled agent-count factor levels for slope
metrics.eligibility: completed sample; agentCount > 0; finite nonnegative time; slope requires same controlled scenario family and frozen levels
metrics.aggregation: per-agent sample value plus distinct factor-level slope estimand
metrics.independentUnit: Williams block; slope uncertainty across frozen factor-level blocks
metrics.zeroMissingNonfiniteTimeout: no cross-family substitution; insufficient levels yields NOT-ESTIMABLE
metrics.forbiddenConclusion: Do not combine unrelated scenario families into an artificial scaling slope.

metrics.name: dynamicManagedAllocatedBytesPerScheduledEvent
metrics.eligibility: completed sample; scheduledEventCount > 0; allocation count finite and nonnegative
metrics.aggregation: sample value; within-block log ratio when strictly positive
metrics.zeroMissingNonfiniteTimeout: zero preserved and not pseudocount-adjusted; missing/nonfinite retained with reason
metrics.forbiddenConclusion: Do not substitute retained managed growth or native working set for allocated bytes.

metrics.name: budgetOverrunRateByOperationType
metrics.eligibility: counts are nonnegative integers; derived repair overrun is between 0 and repairOperationCount
metrics.aggregation: retain numerator and denominator at sample/block/cluster levels
metrics.zeroMissingNonfiniteTimeout: zero-event cells retained; exact or cluster-compatible upper bound; no pseudocount
metrics.forbiddenConclusion: All-zero pilot rates cannot establish superiority or zero future variance.

metrics.name: timeTo95PercentArrival-or-arrivalTimeP95
metrics.formula: future Gate14R movement contract; censoring/completion-curve rule required
metrics.denominator: all eligible agents, including failures and timeouts
metrics.independentUnit: future Gate14R unit not yet frozen
metrics.zeroMissingNonfiniteTimeout: failures cannot be deleted; censoring/timeout handling must be preregistered
metrics.forbiddenConclusion: No Gate12R variance, power, or n_formal may be fabricated.

metrics.name: pathEfficiencyRatio
metrics.formula: actual trajectory cost or distance / independent time-aligned feasible reference
metrics.denominator: validated feasible reference path cost or distance
metrics.independentUnit: future Gate14R unit not yet frozen
metrics.zeroMissingNonfiniteTimeout: reference failures and ratios materially below 1 trigger validation review
metrics.forbiddenConclusion: A ratio below 1 cannot be called better than optimal before reference/time-alignment validation.

metrics.name: completionRateByDeadline
metrics.formula: eligible agents completed by deadline / all eligible agents
metrics.independentUnit: future Gate14R unit not yet frozen
metrics.forbiddenConclusion: Do not calculate only among successful agents.

metrics.name: frameTimeP95Milliseconds
metrics.formula: within-run P95 of preregistered post-warmup frame-time window
metrics.independentUnit: future Gate14R unit not yet frozen
metrics.zeroMissingNonfiniteTimeout: invalid frame telemetry retained and explained
metrics.forbiddenConclusion: OBS-recorded runs cannot enter formal timing inference.

metrics.name: categorizedMovementFailureRate
metrics.formula: categorized failures / all eligible agents, by fixed category and overall
metrics.independentUnit: future Gate14R unit not yet frozen
metrics.forbiddenConclusion: M3 and M5 are correlated and cannot be treated as two independent votes.
